title: What does 'per hundred' ask for?
text: A percent is a numerator when the denominator is 100. So find the number $$n$$ with $$\frac{3}{5} = \frac{n}{100}$$, which means $$n = \frac{3}{5} \times 100$$. A common mistake is to write 3%, or 35. What is $$100 \div 5$$?

title: Multiply by the numerator
text: Each fifth of 100 is 20, and you have 3 fifths. What is $$3 \times 20$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$\frac{3}{5} = \frac{3}{5} \times 100\% = 60\%$$. Common mistake: reading the numerator as the percent. General rule: to convert a fraction to a percent, multiply by 100.
